room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken; medicines, consumables, implants, diagnostics exempt from proportionate clause

copayment.note: Mandatory co-pay is 0%; optional co-pay of 10% or 20% available for premium discount on SI ₹2L and above

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments sub-limited; domiciliary capped at 20% SI/₹50k
sub_limits.note: Robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, stereotactic radio surgery, bronchial thermoplasty etc. each capped at 10–25% of SI subject to ₹50k–₹1L per policy period; domiciliary hospitalisation capped at 20% SI max ₹50k; daily hospital cash 0.1% SI/day max 6 days; ambulance ₹2k or 1% SI whichever less

initial_waiting.note: Accidents exempt; waived after 12 months continuous coverage

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability credit from prior continuous coverage

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (most); 12 months (some ENT/PCOD); 4 years (joint replacement, osteoporosis)
specific_disease_waiting.note: 1 yr: ENT disorders, PCOD; 2 yrs: hernia, hydrocele, cataract, piles, sinusitis, gallbladder, calculus etc.; 4 yrs: joint replacement, osteoporosis, congenital internal diseases; 90 days: hypertension, diabetes

maternity.display: Not covered (standard plan); covered in Diamond Plan
maternity.note: Maternity excluded under standard policy (ExcI 018); covered to extent specified only in Diamond Plan variant; ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Policy mentions health check-up benefit after 3 claim-free years but no cumulative bonus on SI is described in the wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (Appendix I) + any other with prior TPA approval
day_care.note: 116 listed procedures in Appendix I; other day-care treatments covered with prior written approval

domiciliary.note: Excludes treatments lasting ≤3 days and 11 listed diseases (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.)

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to SI in recognised AYUSH hospitals; day-care AYUSH also covered

organ_donor.note: Covers donor's in-patient hospitalisation; excludes organ acquisition cost, donor screening, pre/post-hosp of donor, complications post-harvesting

ambulance.note: Lower of ₹2,000 or 1% of SI per hospitalisation; aggregate cap ₹4,000 per policy period

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, bronchial thermoplasty, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, IONM, stem cell therapy etc. covered with per-policy-period sub-limits of 10–25% SI subject to ₹50k–₹1L caps

consumables.note: Annexure I lists 68+ non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded (gloves, diapers, masks, etc.); Lists II–IV subsume certain items into room/procedure charges

global_cover.display: Not covered (India only; OMP available separately)
global_cover.note: All treatment must be in India; overseas cover available via separate Oriental Overseas Mediclaim Policy (OMP)

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years no look-back except fraud and permanent exclusions; applies separately to enhanced SI portions

grace_period.note: No coverage during grace period; diseases contracted in break period treated as PED

portability.note: Apply at least 45 days before renewal; continuity benefits transferred as per IRDAI portability norms

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, overseas treatment, maternity (standard plan), 16 pre-existing disease categories permanently excluded, refractive error <7.5D, infertility/ART, consumables list

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident cover (up to ₹10L, worldwide); Voluntary co-payment (10%/20% for premium discount)
